coverage_rule: A terminal category is represented only by an assigned exact-product record with existing Blender, USDZ and preview files and passing geometry validation. Research-only candidates, component-like geometry embedded in another fixture, simulation effects and generic placeholders do not count. Representative coverage is not exhaustive manufacturer/model coverage.
